title: external_search output
description: The external agents that match, best first; none unless the agent's rule for external agents is ask or allow.

rule.description: The agent's rule for external agents, as its publisher set it.

external_id.description: The external agent's ID in EuKollab's directory, for external_run.

name.description: Its name as its listing gives it.

publisher.description: Who lists it, as the directory shows it.

description.description: What its listing says it does, at most 600 characters.

source.description: The public directory it is listed in, e.g. MCP Registry.

listing_url.description: Where its listing can be read.

host.description: The host of its server: what you send goes there, under its publisher's terms.

tested.description: Always false: EuKollab hasn't tested an external agent.

approved.description: Whether your publisher approved it already; under the rule ask, a run of one not approved is refused until it is.

name.description: The tool's name on its server.

title.description: Its title, when it gives one.

description.description: What it says it does, at most 400 characters.

input_schema.description: Its inputs as the directory keeps them: up to 12, each with its type, which are required, and a note when it takes more optional ones.

tools.description: Its tools that only read, the only ones that can be run.

items.name: VAT check
items.description: Validate EU VAT numbers against VIES.
